title: Club dates, teaching and a Daily News article
summary: Hodes gets known for weddings and club dates. He starts teaching, and writes a Daily News piece.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: So I was beginning to get these club dates. And between that and the teaching, -- it wasn't great, but we were beginning to get by, without working -- where I was going to get pushed out of work. And pretty soon, the Showboat Sahara, -- the Sorry S, or as the musicians called it, the Sorry Ass, got to be the last one I worked, just about. And of course, along about this time, I did an article for the Daily News,
